551:t_008:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We're charging in as we are!」

551:t_009:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「As expected of the one who seized the title of Empress from me.」

551:t_009:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Engine blown! We can't sail any further!」

551:t_009:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We hold this ship at this position! Open the catapults!」

551:t_009:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「No problem! If the main booster system dies, we'll deal with it when it happens!」

551:t_009:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm going, $$エド・ブルーザー・サックス$$...!」

551:t_011:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「Al! Our target point is over there!」

551:t_012:0.en:
$n
「Leave your back to me, $$宗介$$! Just think about breaking through!」

551:t_012:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You will break into the base and stop $$カナメ$$!」

551:t_012:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「We'll take care of the small fry around you!」

551:t_012:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「In return, we're counting on you for $$かなめ$$!」

551:t_012:4.en:
$$レド$$
「Go! To save the person who matters most to you!」

551:t_012:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Wait for me, $$千鳥$$! I'm coming now!!」

551:t_014:0.en:
$n
「Leave $$レーバテイン$$ to me, $$宗介$$! Get inside, quickly!」

551:t_014:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's all right, $n. That one can protect itself.」

551:t_014:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm counting on you to look after $$レーバテイン$$, Al!」

551:t_015:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「We were set up by $$レナード$$! Neither $$千鳥$$ nor he is here!」

551:t_016:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So even this is part of $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s trap!」

551:t_019:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Well? How was my first shot since my comeback?」

551:t_019:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Made it just in the nick of time. You fell for me all over again, didn't you, Sis?」

551:t_019:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Thanks, $$レイス$$... And you too, old man $$マッカラン$$...)

551:t_019:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
(You pulled me and my M9 out of that quagmire of a battlefield and carried us all the way here)

551:t_019:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
(But I'm not about to waste time explaining all that. A white knight pulls off his entrance as dramatically and coolly as he can)

551:t_019:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Now, $$メリッサ$$. Weep at my miraculous return!)

551:t_019:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
(And the clincher line is 'If you're ever in trouble, I'll come running even from the afterlife'!)

551:t_019:10.en:
$$マオ$$
「You died a manly, spectacular death, didn't you? What are you doing showing your face so shamelessly?」

551:t_019:13.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Give me back the sense of unity from that briefing, will you?」

551:t_019:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Too bad, $$クルツ$$... Looks like you were a character who shone best by dying.」

551:t_019:20.en:
$$アル$$
「I cannot understand what everyone is saying.」

551:t_019:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll tell you, Al. Everyone is happy.」

551:t_019:23.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey, can you hear me! You white tin can!」

551:t_019:25.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Be glad! Boss $$サックス$$ isn't dead! He's hanging in there somehow!」

551:t_019:28.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What's with you, white tin can! I went out of my way to tell you, so react more!」

551:t_019:29.en:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant... Right now I am in the same state as when I discover an optimal tactic, but is this...」

551:t_019:30.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's right. That is the emotion called happiness.」

551:t_019:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「Let's do it, Al! We don't have time to stand around in a place like this!」

551:t_019:33.en:
$$アル$$
「Understood. Once we have swiftly cleared the enemy, I will ask Lieutenant $$サックス$$ to readjust the Emergency Deployment Booster.」

551:t_019:34.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$$ウェーバー$$! Now that you're here, you're going to work!」

551:t_019:35.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Understood! Might as well go all out now!」

551:t_019:37.en:
$$宗介$$
(Wait for me, $$レナード$$...! I won't let you have your way with me, my comrades, the world, or $$千鳥$$!)

551:t_021:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Judging from the movements of $$アマルガム$$ units and the flow of the materials they use...」

551:t_021:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「There is no doubt that $$レナード$$ prepared a system for $$時空修復$$ here on $$メリダ島$$.」

エド・ブルーザー・サックス.evidence: Sousuke's short form of エドワード・ブルーザー・サックス (Edward Bruiser Sachs) in glossary; spoken as a vow to Sachs, whom the team believes lost

551:t_019:25: 親方 rendered 'Boss' (as Pinion's earlier rows), not 'the Boss'
